Launched in 2004, uShip is based in Austin, Texas.

about_short_description.short_description: uShip is online transport marketplace primarily serving the freight, household goods, and vehicle shipping markets.

product.name: Online Shipping Marketplace
product.description: A platform connecting customers with carriers for shipping large items like vehicles, furniture, and freight, enabling users to list shipments, compare quotes, and book transport services.

product.name: Vehicle Shipping Services
product.description: Services for transporting vehicles including cars, boats, motorcycles, RVs, trailers, and vehicle parts from origin to destination.

product.name: Household and Furniture Shipping
product.description: Shipping services for large household items including furniture and appliances, facilitating moves and deliveries.

product.name: LTL Freight Shipping
product.description: Less-than-truckload (LTL) freight shipping solutions for businesses to transport smaller freight shipments efficiently.

product.name: In-Home Delivery Service
product.description: A delivery service for eCommerce retailers and small businesses offering nationwide first-to-final mile delivery and return shipping.

product.name: uShip Payments
product.description: A secure, cashless payment system that holds funds until shipment delivery is confirmed, ensuring payment security for users.
